posts.title: You must drain your battery to 0%

slides.text: You must drain your battery to 0%
THE TRUTH — Modern lithium batteries prefer partial charges. Draining to zero regularly wears them faster — charge to 80%, not to the red line and back.
Share this with the person who still believes it.
